reviewer: Codex author source review; independent approval pending

owner_creation.analysis: maxbufs: The c_int owns a cache budget, -1 for unlimited or a rounded positive block count from ch_setbufspace; it owns no existing cache node.
owner_creation.invariant: Cache budget is policy rather than allocated capacity.
limitations: Only budget/state coupling is reviewed; no unsupported claim of a runtime integer failure or cache-size defect.

aliases_escapes.analysis: maxbufs: ch_get compares copied budget with active nbufs; lowering it neither retires cached pointers nor changes the lifetime of retained nonseekable data.
aliases_escapes.invariant: Budget changes do not invalidate cache nodes safely.
limitations: Only budget/state coupling is reviewed; no unsupported claim of a runtime integer failure or cache-size defect.

callback_targets.analysis: maxbufs: Budget exhaustion selects whether to call ch_addbuf or reuse an old node; neither branch is a callback retained in the scalar.
callback_targets.invariant: Allocation policy does not store callable addresses.
limitations: Only budget/state coupling is reviewed; no unsupported claim of a runtime integer failure or cache-size defect.

invalidation.analysis: maxbufs: The global applies across active file-state changes and is not branded to one filestate capacity or initialized node count.
invalidation.invariant: A global budget is not proof of per-file allocation extent.
limitations: Only budget/state coupling is reviewed; no unsupported claim of a runtime integer failure or cache-size defect.

mutation_commit.analysis: maxbufs: ch_setbufspace rounds size_t then narrows into c_int and clamps below one; this policy commit is separate from allocation/list publication.
mutation_commit.invariant: Budget conversion does not commit a buffer owner.
limitations: Only budget/state coupling is reviewed; no unsupported claim of a runtime integer failure or cache-size defect.

release_pair.analysis: maxbufs: Changing maxbufs never calls free; cache lists are retired by ch_delbufs or permanent ifile disposal.
release_pair.invariant: Budget retirement and storage retirement remain separate.
limitations: Only budget/state coupling is reviewed; no unsupported claim of a runtime integer failure or cache-size defect.

error_cleanup.analysis: maxbufs: ch_addbuf failure disables autobuf and an empty-cache guard records failure; the budget does not own or roll back these error states.
error_cleanup.invariant: Failure handling cannot be inferred from budget alone.
limitations: Only budget/state coupling is reviewed; no unsupported claim of a runtime integer failure or cache-size defect.

signals_handoff.analysis: maxbufs: Raw configuration and active cache counters are read across command operations without an exclusive ownership type.
signals_handoff.invariant: Coupled cache policy remains a raw-core review constraint.
limitations: Only budget/state coupling is reviewed; no unsupported claim of a runtime integer failure or cache-size defect.
